permissionModes.label: Default
permissionModes.description: Asks before edits and commands, per your Antigravity permission settings.

permissionModes.label: Accept edits
permissionModes.description: Approves file edits in the workspace without asking.

permissionModes.label: Auto
permissionModes.description: Approves edits and safe commands; asks before irreversible actions.

permissionModes.label: Plan
permissionModes.description: Plans carefully before executing a task.

permissionModes.label: Bypass permissions
permissionModes.description: Runs everything without asking (--dangerously-skip-permissions). Like a remote terminal.
